name: bolli-dr
description: A fast DR app for LG webOS TVs, Android TV and Google TV

scripts.build: tsc -p . && rollup build/tsc/src/dr/main.js --format iife --file apps/bolli-dr/app.js --silent && node -e "var fs=require('fs'),f='apps/bolli-dr/app.js',v=require('./apps/bolli-dr/appinfo.json').version;fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('__BOLLI_VERSION__').join(v))"
